name: Lifecycle State
notes: Primary reset stopped cranking running keyoff shutdown state

name: Engine Speed
notes: Engineering RPM derived from REF timing

name: Barometric Pressure
notes: Captured from valid MAP before crank and held for run cycle

name: BARO Valid
notes: False if pre-crank MAP capture was not valid

name: Throttle Rate
notes: Filtered rate used by hybrid air model and AE

name: Air Temperature
notes: Absolute temperature used by air model

name: Control Air Temperature
notes: May be substituted while MAT_C remains invalid

name: Control Coolant Temperature
notes: May be substituted while CTS_C remains invalid

name: Speed Density VE
notes: Interpolated VE used in SD estimate

name: Air Model Mode
notes: SD hybrid Alpha N fallback or invalid
